description: A dissociative dust that unplugs you from your own body for a while.

effects.comeon_message: You take the dust and wait. You already feel far away.

events.text: [trip]The floor goes soft and the walls slide back. You start, very gently, to come loose from yourself.[/trip]
[trip]You slide a little further down the smooth grey funnel.[/trip]
[trip]Your body is somewhere behind you now, waving. You wave back, or think about it.[/trip]
[trip]Continents of thought drift past, too large and too slow to be afraid of.[/trip]
[trip]Someone is speaking. It might be you. It was a long time ago.[/trip]
[trip]The funnel widens, tips you out, and hands you back your arms and legs one at a time.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Your body keeps moving but you're not in charge of it. You feel far behind it.

overdose.message: You go too deep to come back, and you stop breathing.

phases.comedown_message: You start to feel your body again, a bit at a time.
phases.end_message: You feel like yourself again. You stay put for a bit anyway.

effects.take_line: You cut out a line of {name} and snort it.

withdrawal.message: You want to go back under. You can't stop thinking about it.

stages.easing: A bit of breathing room comes back by itself.
stages.onset: You're back in your body and you can feel every part of it.
stages.peak: There's no distance between you and anything any more. The drug gave you that distance, and it's gone.
stages.rising: You keep noticing your hands are yours, which you never used to think about.
stages.tail: You're here. You still look for the way out the drug used to give you.

name: ketamine
